question: What directional order governs the placement of the powers giving desired aims?
premises: A power gives the fruit of all desired aims.
The powers proceed in reverse order starting from the west.
This directional rule applies to the group.
inference: The powers, including the giver of all desired aims, are arranged in reverse order from the west.
plain_english: The giver of the fruit of all desired aims; they proceed in reverse order starting from the west.
